snippets.en: Now, behold, I say unto you, that because you delivered up those writings which you had power given unto you to translate by the means of the Urim and Thummim, into the hands of a wicked man, you have lost them.
snippets.tr: Agora, eis que te digo que porque entregaste esses escritos, que recebeste poder para traduzir por meio do Urim e Tumim, nas mãos de um homem iníquo, tu os perdeste.
